name: restaurant-management-software
description: Restaurant management system with order tracking, billing, and delivery management

scripts.install:all: cd apps/server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install && cd ../waiter-pwa && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run dev:server & npm run dev:client & npm run dev:pwa
scripts.build: npm run build:server && npm run build:client && npm run build:pwa
scripts.lint: npm run lint:server && npm run lint:client && npm run lint:pwa
scripts.test: npm run test:server && npm run test:client
scripts.clean: rm -rf apps/server/node_modules apps/server/dist apps/client/.next apps/client/node_modules apps/waiter-pwa/dist apps/waiter-pwa/node_modules
